context: Naoko cleans the shop in early morning; teaches Aoi technique.
purpose: Veteran teaching cleaning technique to younger.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 蒼ちゃん、掃除、丁寧にやで。
lines.en: Aoi-chan, do the cleaning carefully, yeah?
lines.style: Bright, direct Kansai accent. Teaching tone without condescension. Warm firmness on the instruction. A little lean-in, like she's passing down something that matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい、油、ようけ落ちました。
lines.en: Yes — the oil came off pretty well.
lines.style: Soft, attentive voice. Gentle pride in reporting the work done right. A slight lift at the end, seeking quiet approval. Dutiful but not strained.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 汗かいて、頑張ってるね。
lines.en: You're sweating — you're really going at it.
lines.style: Warm Kansai affection underneath. Noticing, appreciating the effort without making a big show of it. Soft laugh in the voice. Pride that sits easy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 洗濯、毎回、決まったやり方で?
lines.en: So... do you always wash the same way each time?
lines.style: Curious, genuine question. Soft voice, leaning in to understand. Not interrogating — wanting to learn what Naoko knows. A little tentative, respectful.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おう、習慣にしたら、楽や。
lines.en: Yeah, if you make it a habit, it gets easier.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact Kansai wisdom. Not lecturing — just sharing something true from experience. Slow, settled pace. Like she's tending something.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 改善、続けて、頑張ります。
lines.en: I'll keep working on getting better at this.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Warm, earnest tone. Steady resolve without strain. A small nod in the voice — taking the lesson in, making it her own.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、ええ職人になるで!
lines.en: Ha — you're gonna make a fine craftsperson!
lines.style: Bright, genuine pride. Kansai warmth blooming. A tender laugh underneath. Not flattering — observing something real she sees in Aoi. Encouraging, tender.
